item.title: Concho County Hospital Converts to Rural Emergency Hospital to Sustain Services
item.description: EDEN, TX — In a move to preserve essential healthcare access for residents of Concho County and surrounding areas, the Concho County Hospital District board of directors has approved the conversion of Concho County Hospital from a Critical Access Hospital to a Rural Emergency Hospital (REH). The decision, announced on January 29, 2026, comes as rural hospitals across Texas grapple with financial pressures that have led to numerous closures and service reductions. Learn More Here.

item.title: Bonham Elementary to Celebrate 40th Anniversary With Sheep Unveiling
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Bonham Elementary School will mark its 40th anniversary Friday with the unveiling of a fiberglass sheep.The ceremony will begin at 2:30 p.m. at the school campus, located at 4630 Southland Blvd. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Tennis Begins Spring Campaign this Weekend
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State women’s tennis team will open its 2026 spring season Friday when it hosts Weatherford College at the ASU Tennis Courts. The match is scheduled to begin at 2 p.m. The Rambelles start their fourth spring season under head coach Jason Potthoff, coming off a 15-7 campaign in 2025. Learn More Here.

item.title: Teachers Leave San Angelo ISD 'High and Dry'
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX – The San Angelo Independent School District Board of Trustees unanimously voted to submit complaints to the State Board for Educator Certification against two teachers — Perla Garcia and Ida Pinnell-Luce — for abandoning their contracts mid-year without district consent or good cause, during the Jan. 20, 2026, regular meeting. item.title: Reagan County ISD Teacher's Aide Arrested for Improper Relationships With Students
item.description: BIG LAKE, TX — A Reagan County High School teacher’s aide has been arrested for allegedly having sexual relationships with several male students.According to court documents received from the Reagan County Justice of the Peace Office, on Tuesday, Jan. 13, 2026, around 3:41 p.m., two investigators with the Reagan County Sheriff’s Office Criminal Investigation Division were dispatched to the Reagan County ISD superintendent’s office. Learn More Here.

item.title: Governor Abbott Issues Statewide Disaster Declaration Amid Looming Screwworm Threat to Livestock Industry
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX – On January 29, 2026, Texas Governor Greg Abbott issued a statewide disaster declaration aimed at preventing the potential infestation of the New World screwworm (NWS) fly, a parasitic pest that poses a significant risk to the state's livestock industry and wildlife populations. The move comes as reports indicate the screwworm's northward progression from Mexico, with recent outbreaks confirmed in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas, just across the border from Texas. Learn More Here

item.title: WATCH: Angelo State Baseball Opens 2026 on the Road
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State Rams will open the 2026 season on the road this weekend with a three-game Lone Star Conference series against the UT Permian Basin Falcons.Due to unplayable field conditions, Friday’s opener will be played at Odessa College’s Wrangler Field. The teams hope to complete the remainder of the series at UTPB’s Roden Field.The series begins Friday at 2 p.m., followed by games at 1 p.m. Saturday and Sunday. Learn More Here.
